stage: declared after implementation and before first execution; tolerances remain in the earlier frozen config
required_vs_diagnostic: All finite-domain integrals must agree with their exact finite-domain reference. All coarse truncation, quadrature and finite-difference comparisons are retained against the same frozen finest tolerance; only the finest sweep member is a required accuracy gate. Measured fourth-order finite-difference and asymptotic second-order tail convergence are required. Independent surface-integral reference agreement is required at both resolutions.
boundary_scope: Largest-depth tail threshold applies to the declared 1 kpc ray only, not arbitrary rays or a guarantee for real field boundaries. Default radial/asymmetric benchmarks use the ideal infinite map. No analytic tail correction is inserted into the operator.
